source.name: Patched 4chan Archive Ten Billion (repaired & updated)
source.short-desc: Repaired re-dump of the text-only 'Ten Billion' 4chan thread archive, 2005-2008
source.capture:
One 7.8GB payload, chanarchive_dump_v2.sql.gz, plus IA bookkeeping and two thumbnails. Surveyed against archive.org/metadata: 8 files, no image payloads, so no download.exclude is needed.

WHAT IT COVERS: the uploader describes it as a patch/re-dump of the 'Ten Billion' text-only 4chan thread archive — 10.8 million threads and 162 million posts from 2005-2008, originally scraped by an anonymous source, packaged in 2009 and later served by old.sage.moe. That date range is earlier than almost anything else in the registry: the corpus currently has only a few thousand posts before 2008.

THIS REPLACES 4chan_threads_archive_10_billion, which is now marked dead-end. That item is the same corpus in three renderings, all of them subsets of this one. Per this uploader: 'The XML and HTML formats in the original upload are subsets of the data in chanarchive.tar.gz (e.g. the XML version is missing /b/ and /p/; the HTML version is missing timestamps and post numbers, and its /b/ is corrupt; both are missing /con/)' — which matches that manifest's independent survey exactly. This item takes the original's chanarchive.tar.gz (a tar of raw MyISAM files, which no adapter could read without attaching them to a MySQL server), patches the SINGLE corrupt byte at offset 0x8cee0ac3 that garbled the posts table past a certain point, and republishes it as a mysqldump for MySQL 5.7/8. Ingest this, not that.

SCHEMA IS NOT PER-BOARD, WHICH RULES OUT EVERY EXISTING SQL ADAPTER. The uploader: 'The imported DB will have a single posts table and a single threads table. You can write a join between them to match posts to their thread numbers, source websites (a handful are from outside 4Chan) and boards.' Both fuuka-sql and warosu-sql identify a board by the TABLE NAME and read one table per board; here there is one flat posts table and the board lives in a column, reachable only through a join to threads. Neither adapter can express that, and both fail silently rather than erroring when no table matches — so a clean exit code from either would mean nothing. A new adapter is required; ingest.adapter is null deliberately.

THE `site` COLUMN IS NOT ALWAYS 4chan. The threads table carries a source website and 'a handful are from outside 4Chan'. ingest.site is set to 4chan as the default, but the adapter MUST read the per-thread source rather than stamping every row with the manifest value — otherwise foreign posts are misattributed and, worse, could collide with real 4chan post numbers under UNIQUE (site, board, post_no) and silently displace genuine rows.

Timestamp handling is unresolved: the Fuuka family stores America/New_York wall time and needs nyWallToUtc, but whether this dump does is unknown. The XML rendering of the same data showed minute-precision dates with no seconds and no timezone ('2006-09-16 23:23'), so seconds may simply not exist here either — record them as :00 rather than guessing, and cross-check a shared post against another archive before trusting the offset.

prepare.name: decompress the gzipped mysqldump
prepare.run: mkdir -p extracted && find . -name '*.sql.gz' -not -path './out/*' -not -path './extracted/*' | while read -r f; do b=$(basename "${f%.gz}"); [ -e "extracted/$b" ] || [ -e "out/$b" ] || gunzip -c "$f" > "extracted/$b"; done

prepare.name: stage the .sql dump for ingest
prepare.run: mkdir -p out && find extracted -name '*.sql' -exec sh -c 'cp -al "$1" out/ 2>/dev/null || cp -a "$1" out/' _ {} ';'
